name: Summon Spirit of Awakening (General)
body:
You can summon spirits to possess mundane objects.

Prerequisite(s): summon monster or summon nature’s ally spell or ability.

Benefit(s): Add the following creatures to the list you can summon with summon monster and summon nature’s ally spells. Using this ability requires a separate focus item for each creature, a miniature replica of the object the summoned creature looks like. You get to select any ability options each creature has, like the construction points of animated objects. This not include any additional options or add-on abilities exceptional creatures of this type might have. You can only give a summoned creature alignment or domain specific abilities if you have that alignment or domain. Spell-like abilities with a duration other than instantaneous used by summoned creatures from this list are dispelled when the summoned creature disappears.

Abilities usable on a weekly or longer basis are unavailable to creatures summoned this way.

Summon monster or Summon nature’s ally I: animated object (tiny), homunculus (any poison ends when the creature disappears, though harmful effects such as damage remain), leaf ray (no seed), gourd leshy, xtabay
Summon monster or Summon nature’s ally II: animated object (small) (no construction points or hardness), celedon, jack o’ lantern, gourd leshy, gluttongrass, leaf ray (no seed)
Summon monster or Summon nature’s ally III: animated object (small), foo dog, fungus leshy, koto-furunishi, raktavarna rakshasa, shikigami kami, soulbound doll, waxwork human (no regeneration)
Summon monster or Summon nature’s ally IV: animated object (medium), foo lion, guardian scroll, flytrap leshy, gargoyle, kasa-obake tsukumogami, scarecrow, seaweed leshy, taxidermic grizzly bear
Summon monster or Summon nature’s ally V: animated object (large), boroboroton tsukumogami, graven guardian, kodama kami, lotus leshy, skinstitch, terra cotta soldier
Summon monster or Summon nature’s ally VI: animated object (huge), treant (cannot animate trees), soulbound mannequin, urannag, cephalophore, tupilaq
Summon nature’s ally VII: animated object (gargantuan), cryptguard, kapre, tophet, tiberolith, zuishin kami
Summon monster or Summon nature’s ally VIII: animated object (colossal), bonethorn, juggernaut, soulbound shell, taotieh
Summon nature’s ally IX: kikituk, wickerman
